note: Charges a broker applies to a client trade, as published. Brokerage commission is negotiable between broker and client; the levies are statutory and do not vary by broker. A market with no published schedule on file carries null rather than an invented figure, and the calculator says so on the panel.

NSE.source: Faida Investment Bank, published client charges (fib.co.ke/faqs)
NSE.also: Stanbic Bank Kenya quotes the same round trip as 1.85% rather than 1.84% on a consideration above KES 100,000; the difference is rounding in the brokerage line.

taxes.capitalGainsNote: Kenya charges capital gains tax at 15% on the transfer of property and of unlisted shares; a sale on the exchange is not charged it.
taxes.dividendNote: Withholding on dividends paid to a resident individual is a final tax at 5%.

NGX.note: No published broker schedule is on file for the Nigerian Exchange, so the calculator charges no fees for this market until a rate is entered. An invented levy would be worse than a zero the reader can see.

taxes.capitalGainsNote: Nigeria charges capital gains tax on the disposal of shares; the panel starts it at 10% and the rate is editable.
taxes.dividendNote: Withholding on dividends to a resident is 10%.

JSE.note: No published broker schedule is on file for the Johannesburg exchange, so the calculator charges no fees for this market until a rate is entered.

taxes.capitalGainsNote: Capital gains are not a levy on the trade in South Africa: the gain is included in the investor's taxable income at the inclusion rate, so no fixed rate is applied here unless one is entered.

EGX.note: No published broker schedule is on file for the Egyptian Exchange, so the calculator charges no fees for this market until a rate is entered.

taxes.capitalGainsNote: No rate is applied to the gain for this market unless one is entered on the panel.
taxes.dividendNote: No dividend rate is applied for this market unless one is entered on the panel.
